label: HEALING

cover.headline: Letting go of *“the one that got away”*

points.heading: Notice the highlight reel
points.body: Memory keeps the best moments and edits out the rest.
points.panel: Write down one hard moment you’ve been forgetting.

points.heading: Ask what you really miss
points.body: Sometimes it’s the feeling, not the person.
points.panel: “Do I miss him, or how I felt then?”

points.heading: Honor what it gave you
points.body: It can matter and still be over.

points.heading: Make room for the new
points.body: Holding on can leave little space for what’s next.
points.panel: Say yes to one new plan this week.

points.heading: Be patient with yourself
points.body: Letting go is gradual, not a single moment.
points.panel: “I’m loosening my grip, a little at a time.”

close.save: Save this for the nostalgic nights.

caption:
Some relationships turn into a story we keep retelling: the one that got away, the one that might have been.

That story can quietly keep you stuck. These five gentle steps help you loosen it, honor what it meant, and make room for what’s next. You deserve a story that moves forward.

Save this for the nostalgic nights, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
